summary: Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing the notice of convocation and proxy card for an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders to be held in Tokyo on November 30, 2026, with a written-voting deadline of 1:00 p.m. JST on November 27, 2026. Shareholders will vote on the appropriation of surplus, including a proposed cash dividend of JPY1.432 per ordinary share, and on a board-approved reduction of stated capital by JPY284,419,000 from JPY294,419,000 to JPY10,000,000, with the reduction transferred to capital reserve. The capital reduction requires shareholder approval and Japanese creditor-protection procedures, with effectiveness expected December 11, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice and capital-accounting matter, not a special situation; watch the vote outcome and creditor-objection window rather than any deal arbitrage angle.
